messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands on a cobblestone street, then turns and walks forward while swinging their arms.","camera":"A medium full-body shot from behind that follows the person as they move away from the camera.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top, teal shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"Dark brown.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high top-knot bun with a light-colored hair tie.","identity":"A muscular person with a broad back and shoulders, seen mostly from behind.","scene":"A sunlit city street with red brick buildings, shop awnings, a Union Jack flag, and a cobblestone road."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunny waterfront terrace to a cobblestone city street with red brick buildings, awnings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag, closely matching the reference. The person remains in a white tank top, teal shorts, and pink sneakers, with a high bun, and continues a similar turning/walking motion from behind.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside scene with the reference city street environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was fully preserved, since the face is mostly not visible from behind.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin tone and body rendering appear slightly different in the new scene, with a more game-like/CG look in some frames.
